title: RAW UNREVIEWED: mixed bath supply versus consecutive hot and cold baths
summary: GDT591 has a coherent formal body/station episode but no confirmed patient or water meaning. Find a historical bathing instruction that explicitly assigns two differently conditioned inputs to one shared vessel and names the resulting condition, with a contrasting instruction applying the same two conditions successively. Freeze both complete source procedures and the owner of each input, vessel and recipient before any admitted target reading. A complete candidate target must distinguish converging inputs from temporal succession under one consistent mapping; hot/cold labels alone do not count. Eligibility of source pair and target relation is unknown.

design.mechanism: two source-owned conditioned inputs converge on one vessel and produce one resulting bath state
design.unit: two complete historically owned bathing instructions and complete already admitted biological records
design.contrast: simultaneous mixture into one bath versus two sequential applications
design.prediction: a frozen whole reading preserves two input owners, one mixture recipient and the resulting state, while the rival preserves two event times; absent independent endpoint binding yields no semantic score
